title: Intelligent Grid
tagline: The Excel-like data grid for the browser: 100 000 rows at 60 fps, formulas, ranges, undo, grouping, import and export.

hero.alt: Intelligent Grid with data bars, color scales, icon sets, sparklines and a pinned column

highlights.title: Huge data, smooth scroll
highlights.text: Row and column virtualization: 100 000 rows open in under half a second and scroll at 60 fps.

highlights.title: Feels like a spreadsheet
highlights.text: Ranges, copy and paste with Excel, fill handle series, undo and redo, find and replace, comments.

highlights.title: 137 Excel functions
highlights.text: Calculated columns, cell formulas, footers and structured references like =[@qty]*[@price].

highlights.title: Filters people understand
highlights.text: Excel AutoFilter, search, and a visual query builder that writes MongoDB-style JSON.

highlights.title: Group and analyze
highlights.text: Collapsible groups with subtotals, data bars, color scales, icon sets and sparklines.

highlights.title: Real import and export
highlights.text: CSV and XLSX in both directions, without dependencies, formulas kept as Excel formulas.

highlights.title: Live server data
highlights.text: Infinite scroll over fetch or WebSocket, and Server-Sent Events loading 100 000 rows in blocks.

highlights.title: Forms-ready change tracking
highlights.text: Inserted, updated and deleted rows as JSON, history, accept and discard.

highlights.title: Typed, themable, translated
highlights.text: TypeScript, CSS variables with dark mode, English and Portuguese out of the box.

languages.label: Português (Brasil)
languages.tagline: A grade de dados estilo Excel para o navegador: 100 000 linhas a 60 fps, fórmulas, intervalos, desfazer, grupos, importação e exportação.
